reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified correct: line 328 performs unchecked indexed access cell_proofs[i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB + j] without validating cell_proofs.len >= blobs.len * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB. Spec requirement from 01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json property PROP-57888860-inv-027 explicitly requires 'len(result) == len(blobs) * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB'. Reviewed all three callers: RPC handler (rest_beacon_api.nim:1108-1110) passes untrusted kzg_proofs from REST body without validation; validator path (beacon_validators.nim:587-589) uses engineBlock.blobsBundle.proofs from EL without checking structure; Engine API response handler (nimbus_beacon_node.nim:2048-2057) flattens proofs without verifying each blob has exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB proofs. Attack scenario confirmed: attacker submits block with N blobs but fewer than N*CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB proofs via RPC → IndexDefect panic → node crash (DoS). Severity calibrated per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE: single-node DoS via single malicious RPC call, Nimbus is single consensus client implementation, matches Medium threshold for >5% network impact via single input.
